subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Synthetic Oils: Engineered Molecules
description: A fast breakdown of Synthetic Oils: Engineered Molecules for builders.

hook.text: Crude oil is random. Synthetic oil is built molecule by molecule.

buildup.text: Natural oils have mixed molecular lengths. Synthetics are uniform and pure.

discovery.text: Uniform molecules flow predictably, resist heat, and last far longer.

twist.text: They cost more but extend drain intervals. Total cost can be lower.

climax.text: Jets, race cars, and arctic gear all depend on synthetic lubricants.

punchline.text: Build the molecule right and the oil handles itself.

quiz.question: Why do synthetic oils outperform conventional oils?
options: They're made from plants that are naturally slippery
Uniform molecules give predictable flow, heat resistance, and long life
They contain metal particles that fill surface scratches
